en.hubeali: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The water of the large well, nothing would pollute it except if it is changed by it (the filth)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Through the same chain of narrators as the previous Hadith the following is stated: “He (the Imam) ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘
Well water is vast. It does not become polluted until it is changed.’”
